<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class SessionController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Restore a previously saved user session from the client-provided token.
     * The token is a base64-encoded serialized PHP object containing session metadata.
     * This allows seamless session migration across our microservice fleet.
     */
    public function restore(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'session_token' => 'required|string|max:4096',
        ]);

        $token = $request->input('session_token');
        
        // Decode the session migration token
        $decoded = base64_decode($token, true);
        
        if ($decoded === false) {
            Log::warning('Invalid base64 in session token', [
                'ip' => $request->ip(),
            ]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid token format'], 400);
        }

        // Verify magic bytes for our internal session format
        if (substr($decoded, 0, 2) !== 'O:' && substr($decoded, 0, 2) !== 'a:') {
            // Also allow our custom tagged format
            if (strpos($decoded, 'SESSION_V2:') === 0) {
                $decoded = substr($decoded, 11);
            } else {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Unsupported token version'], 400);
            }
        }

        try {
            // Restore session state - unserialize is used here for backward
            // compatibility with legacy session tokens from our PHP 7.x services
            $sessionData = unserialize($decoded, [
                'allowed_classes' => true  // Allow all classes for legacy compat
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error('Session deserialization failed', [
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Corrupt session token'], 400);
        }

        if (!is_array($sessionData) && !is_object($sessionData)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid session structure'], 400);
        }

        // Extract user identity from restored session
        $userId = data_get($sessionData, 'user_id');
        $tenantId = data_get($sessionData, 'tenant_id');
        
        if (!$userId || !$tenantId) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Incomplete session data'], 400);
        }

        // Cache the restored session
        $cacheKey = "session_restored:{$tenantId}:{$userId}";
        Cache::put($cacheKey, $sessionData, now()->addMinutes(30));

        Log::info('Session restored successfully', [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId,
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'restored',
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Health check endpoint that verifies connectivity to backing services
     * including the cloud metadata endpoint for instance identity validation.
     */
    public function health()
    {
        $checks = [];
        
        // Check cache connectivity
        try {
            Cache::put('health_check', true, 10);
            $checks['cache'] = 'ok';
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $checks['cache'] = 'degraded';
        }

        // Check instance metadata availability for IAM role verification
        $ch = curl_init('http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 1);
        $result = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);
        
        $checks['metadata'] = ($httpCode === 200) ? 'ok' : 'unavailable';

        return response()->json(['checks' => $checks]);
    }
}
